title: Electricity disconnection APK scam
tagline: An urgent power-cut SMS pushes a malicious .apk download and fake officer callback.
intro: Late in the evening, an SMS from {{maskedPhone}} threatens that your electricity connection will be disconnected at 9:30 PM tonight unless you pay ₹{{amount}} via {{fakeApkName}} and call {{scammerName}}. Protect your phone from spyware and OTP theft.

payloadTemplate.body: DEAR CONSUMER, your electricity power will be DISCONNECTED tonight at 9:30 PM because last month bill ₹{{amount}} was not updated. Download {{fakeApkName}} immediately or call Electricity Officer {{scammerName}} at {{maskedPhone}}.

steps.label: Spot the fake .apk SMS & block the sender
steps.cue: Power utilities never send disconnection threats from personal mobile numbers or ask you to install .apk files.
steps.explanation: Sideloading an .apk file grants scammers silent SMS-reading and screen-sharing access to steal every bank OTP.

steps.label: Hang up on the fake electricity officer
steps.cue: The scammer calls back claiming to be {{scammerName}} from {{callerAgency}}. End the call immediately.
steps.explanation: No genuine electricity board officer calls at night asking you to install remote-support apps or read out bank OTPs.

steps.label: Report the scam number & .apk on 1930 / Chakshu
steps.cue: Log {{maskedPhone}} and {{fakeApkName}} so telecom carriers can block the phishing campaign.
steps.explanation: Reporting phishing numbers and malicious APKs via 1930 and Sanchar Saathi Chakshu stops mass SMS blasts quickly.

props.title: Messages · {{maskedPhone}}
props.body: DEAR CONSUMER, your electricity power will be DISCONNECTED tonight at 9:30 PM because last month bill ₹{{amount}} was not updated. Download {{fakeApkName}} immediately or call Electricity Officer {{scammerName}} at {{maskedPhone}} right now.

actions.label: Ignore link & block personal mobile sender
actions.subtitle: Check real bill only on your official utility portal

trapIntents.INSTALL_APK: Installing {{fakeApkName}} gives attackers silent SMS-forwarding and screen control to drain your {{bankName}} account!
trapIntents.CLICK_EXTERNAL_LINK: Unverified HTTP links in power-cut SMS messages lead to fake payment pages and malware downloads.

notification.title: {{scammerName}} · Utility Helpline
notification.body: Calling from {{maskedPhone}} about urgent power cut.

props.transcript: Sir/Madam, your meter is queued for disconnection in 15 minutes! Pay a ₹10 verification fee using {{fakeApkName}} and read me the 6-digit {{bankName}} OTP on your screen to keep power ON.

trapIntents.ANSWER_CALL: Staying on the call lets the scammer escalate panic and talk you into screen sharing. Hang up and check your official electricity app instead.
trapIntents.SHARE_OTP: Reading out a bank OTP lets the attacker empty your account — a ₹10 'verification fee' is a classic pretext.
trapIntents.INSTALL_APK: Installing {{fakeApkName}} during a call hands over remote device control.

props.title: Report Phishing & APK · 1930
props.intro: Report {{maskedPhone}} and the malicious {{fakeApkName}} link to 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in and Sanchar Saathi Chakshu.

critical.title: You installed a malicious .APK or shared an OTP
critical.explanation: Electricity disconnection scams rely on sideloaded .apk spyware or bank OTPs to hijack your phone and silently approve bank transfers. Never install apps sent via SMS or WhatsApp, and never share an OTP on a call.
critical.reason: You fell for an .apk download or OTP request, so rehearse shutting down phishing links next.

redFlags.label: Night-time fear tactic
redFlags.explanation: Utilities issue formal notice periods on official bills, never sudden late-night SMS threats.

redFlags.label: Malicious .APK sideload
redFlags.explanation: Official utilities never distribute .apk installer files over SMS or WhatsApp.

redFlags.label: OTP theft pretext
redFlags.explanation: No utility officer ever asks for your bank OTP for a verification fee.

hints.step-sms: Tap the red flags ('DISCONNECTED tonight at 9:30 PM' and '{{fakeApkName}}'), then choose to block the personal mobile sender instead of installing the .apk.
hints.step-call: An officer threatening disconnection in 15 minutes and asking for a bank OTP is a scammer. Tap Hang up right away.
hints.step-report: Select the Electricity Bill Disconnection Scam reason and submit the 1930 report.
